# opnsense_haproxy_acl (Resource)

A HAProxy condition (ACL). Rules (`opnsense_haproxy_action`) use conditions to decide when they apply. Requires the `os-haproxy` plugin.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_haproxy_acl" "host" {
  name       = "host-web"
  expression = "hdr_end"
  value      = ".web.example.com"
}

resource "opnsense_haproxy_acl" "acme_path" {
  name       = "path-acme-challenge"
  expression = "path_beg"
  value      = "/.well-known/acme-challenge/"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `expression` (String) HAProxy fetch the condition tests, e.g. `hdr_end` (Host header ends with), `path_beg` (path starts with), `src` (source IP) or `custom_acl` (raw ACL expression). One of `custom_acl`, `hdr`, `hdr_beg`, `hdr_end`, `hdr_reg`, `hdr_sub`, `path`, `path_beg`, `path_dir`, `path_end`, `path_reg`, `path_sub`, `src`, `ssl_fc_sni`, `ssl_sni`.
- `name` (String) Name to identify this condition. Must not contain `.`, `,`, `;`, brackets, braces or tabs.
- `value` (String) Value matched by `expression`, e.g. `.example.com` for `hdr_end` or `/.well-known/acme-challenge/` for `path_beg`.

### Optional

- `case_sensitive` (Boolean) When enabled, the match is case-sensitive. Defaults to `false`.
- `description` (String) Description for this condition. Defaults to `""`.
- `negate` (Boolean) When enabled, the result of the condition is inverted. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the condition.
